snippet.title: Power Sink - Out Now!
snippet.description:
Power Sink is now available on Steam and Nintendo Switch!
Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/2289740/Power_Sink/
Nintendo eShop → https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/power-sink-switch/

Dive deep into an atmospheric underwater world full of puzzles, pressure, and mystery.

Join our community on Discord → https://discord.gg/93DzHw2Sad
Follow our socials  → https://linktr.ee/winterwiregames
Website → https://winterwiregames.com/

About the Game
Descend into the ruins of a submerged power plant where light flickers, machinery groans, and secrets wait below.
As the Diver, your mission is to restore power to a long-forgotten underwater station and uncover the mystery behind a once-thriving colony’s collapse. Navigate failing structures, reactivate ancient systems, and reconnect your community—before it's too late.

Thank you to Screenwest for supporting us in making Power Sink!
